# yakogl-tools record: the expected decode and classify of one record per block
# (tools/yakogl-tools/src/recordcmd.rs, test decode_matches_golden).

# (in tools/cts/, deleted in Step 1) for the same records (record.rs's classify
# printed the same 44);
# the last block, kind 15, has no Python token (the kind is new; record.rs
# classifies it "fingerprint", never a verdict). The decode
# lines are record.rs's describe() line, then the host's additions (dEQP names
# from tools/cts/gles2-mustpass.txt, the DEQP_CASES bits, the WDOG and
# console stage 1 field names).
